summary:
SANDBACH UNITED - THIS WEEKEND'S FIXTURES PREVIEW

It's a crucial weekend in the First Division South as the season reaches its fourth round of fixtures. Sandbach United will be looking to bounce back after last Wednesday's disappointing 3-2 defeat away at Foley Meir, but the team showed character to claim an important 1-0 victory at home against Stafford Town on Saturday.

The Bach sit in 7th place with 6 points from 3 matches, but this weekend presents an opportunity to climb the table. Most notably, Sandbach face New Mills on Sunday in what promises to be an intriguing encounter. New Mills are currently in 6th place, also on 6 points, so this is effectively a battle between two of the division's mid-table contenders. Both teams will be eager to pick up three points and build momentum.

Looking at the wider context of the weekend, Wolverhampton Casuals continue to set the pace at the top with three wins from three games. They're establishing themselves as the team to beat, though there's still a long season ahead. AFC Bridgnorth remain the only other unbeaten side, sitting second with two wins. The gap between the top and bottom is already significant, which emphasizes how important it is for teams like Sandbach to maintain their winning starts.

Other notable fixtures this weekend include Stafford Town's trip to Alsager Town. Stafford have made a strong start to the season with two wins and a draw, and they'll be looking to maintain their promotion credentials. Eccleshall, who started slowly with a defeat before two wins, host Foley Meir in what should be a competitive match.

Market Drayton Town, currently pointless at the bottom, host Crewe. Both teams will be desperate for their first win of the season, making this a genuine six-pointer at the wrong end of the table.

The form guide suggests Sandbach's encounter with New Mills will be competitive but winnable. Both teams are similar in quality and points, and three points would significantly boost The Bach's chances of mounting a serious challenge for the top spots.
